Progress

Used to display the current progress of the operation (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Sample Code

1. Basic Usage

The progress bar is blue by default, and the current progress can be set through the percentage property.


<maui-progress percentage='50' />

2. line thickness

stroke-width can set the thickness of the progress bar.


<maui-progress percentage='50' stroke-width='8' />

3. Gray Out

The progress bar will be grayed out by setting the inactive attribute.


<maui-progress inactive percentage='50' />

4. Custom Style

Use the pivot-text attribute to customize the text and the color attribute to customize the progress bar color.


<maui-progress pivot-text='Orange' color='#f2826a' percentage='25' />

<maui-progress pivot-text='Red' color='#ee0a24' percentage='50' />

<maui-progress
  percentage='75'
  pivot-text='Purple'
  pivot-color='#7232dd'
  color='linear-gradient(to right, #be99ff, #7232dd)'
/>

API

Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
inactive Whether to gray out Boolean false
percentage progress percentage Number 0
stroke-width progress bar thickness, default unit is px String | Number 4px
show-pivot Whether to display progress text Boolean true
color progress bar color String #1989fa
text-color progress text color String #fff
track-color track color String #e5e5e5
pivot-text text display String percent text
pivot-color text background color String same color as the progress bar
